# Fanfarr v0.2.0

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why. This is
the first tagged release; everything below is what has accumulated in it.

## Cut a theme down to the part that matters

A theme is often two minutes of slow build-up, and Plex plays it from the top.
Fanfarr can now find the ninety seconds worth keeping and write only those.

**Suggest a crop** on an item page scores every window of the theme and proposes
one. It leads with how much is actually happening -- loudness over time -- and
uses repetition only to break ties, because repetition on its own favours quiet
recurring motifs over the tune people recognise. Nothing is written until you
drag the handles and apply it, and the result is stored as two numbers, so a
crop can be widened later without downloading anything again.

Theme crop in Settings sets the length, the shortest theme worth cropping, and
whether the waveform shows the graph the suggestion came from. A theme shorter
than the crop length is skipped rather than padded out to fit, which matters on
a library of TV themes: most of them are shorter than a film theme.

## The library page says more

Columns are now yours to pick: year, type, critics, audience, studio, theme
status, size, length, date added, season count. Size and length are what Fanfarr
wrote, read back off the files. Every id is a link to IMDb, TMDb or TVDb, so
checking which film you are looking at no longer means a search.

## Each root folder reports how much room is left

The root folder check already said whether a mount was accessible and writable.
It now also reports free space, so a drive filling up is visible in Settings
before it is a failed job.

## A much smaller image

The image is 191 MB instead of 655 MB, and 101 MB to pull instead of 274 MB.
Nearly all of the difference was ffmpeg: Debian's package is 492 MB across 233
dependencies -- LLVM, Mesa, speech synthesis, Intel's Media SDK, the Z3 solver
-- none of which this app can reach. It calls ffmpeg for four things, so ffmpeg
is now built from source with only those four things in it, and the two
binaries total 7 MB.

## Security

`mix hex.audit` reports nothing. Eight advisories were open against
`ash_authentication` (two critical, one high), `mint` (one high) and `igniter`,
and the fixes are in 4.15.0, 1.10.1 and 0.8.4 respectively. Three of them
applied to how this app signs in, since it uses the password and remember-me
strategies.

## Upgrading

Nothing to do. Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on
boot. Two notes if you have been running an earlier build:

- Free space on existing root folders shows up the first time you press
  **Re-check** in Settings. Health is observed on demand rather than on every
  page load, so the older rows are empty until then.
- If you rely on themes that are shorter than the configured crop length, check
  Theme crop in Settings. The default crop is 90 seconds and a shorter theme is
  left alone entirely rather than being written at full length.
